_readme: THE BLOCKING SAMPLED REVIEW LEDGER. scripts/inventory-coverage.py --check READS
this file and blocks the next batch when the previous one has no recorded
sample, was reviewed by a non-fresh reviewer, or scored below 80%.
⛔ THIS IS A GATE, NOT A PROCESS STEP. Plan B had the sampled review as a
process step with no mechanism, and this repo record is that process steps
decay and mechanisms do not. A ledger CI does not read is a process step
⛔ WHY THE REVIEWER MUST BE FRESH-CONTEXT. A reviewer who authored the batch
rubber-stamps their own summary. `reviewer_context` must read `fresh`, and
recording it as fresh when it was not is the one lie this whole mechanism
cannot detect — which is exactly why it is written down rather than assumed.
RUBRIC, one yes/no per sampled entry:
Would a competent RavenClaude user learn something they could NOT have
guessed from the title plus the 200-character summary?
SAMPLE: 25% stratified across artifact classes, minimum 3.

note: ⛔ THIS BATCH IS DELIBERATELY BLOCKED, AND THAT IS THE MECHANISM WORKING.
The wave-1 entries were authored by the same session that built the gate.
Recording that session as a fresh-context reviewer would be precisely the
self-review this ledger exists to prevent, so `reviewer_context` reads
therefore BLOCKS, which is the designed end state for wave 1 — the plan
says so directly: the nuance bar is not machine-checkable end to end, and
there is a required human/fresh-model step that IS the real gate.
TO CLEAR IT: a reviewer with no memory of the authoring session grades the
three sampled entries against the rubric above, then sets `reviewer`,
`reviewer_context: fresh`, and the three `verdicts`. At or above 80% the
gate opens; below it, wave 1 is reworked before wave 2 may begin.
⛔ check-nuance-floor.py --golden names, every run, which adversarial
negatives cleared the deterministic floor UNCAUGHT. Those are caught only
here. This step is not ceremony.
sample_rationale: hook-message-channels — the largest covers[] (47 hooks) and the owner own
worked example, so a restatement here would be the most expensive one.
must-fail-conventions-diverge — the script class, tier: effect.
hook-emitter-collision — a tier: none entry, so the sample includes one
whose honesty rests entirely on its written rationale.
